digest.component_or_area: test_concurrency_regression.py test fixture and sync patterns
propositions: 23 sites in test_concurrency_regression.py rely on `_engine_run(...)` side effects to establish fixture preconditions, but `ensure_fresh`'s best-effort contract silently swallows failures, causing silent test setup flakes under CI load

8 of the 23 sites are load-bearing preconditions where one clone must be synchronized to a peer's pushed state; these should use deterministic `_sync_from_origin` (checked fetch + ff-only merge) instead of incidental engine syncs

15 of the 23 sites test the production read-side reconvergence path itself, so converting them to raw git would delete the invariant they exist to prove; these should be encapsulated in a named `_reconverge_by_read_sync` helper with documented rationale

After converting Kind-P preconditions to `_sync_from_origin`, all tests pass under `REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off` (the original flake reproduction condition), eliminating the silent setup failures that produced misleading or absent test failure signatures
